sections.name: Path to Glory
sections.text: Here, you will find additional rules to use with a Sylvaneth army while playing through a Path to Glory campaign. The Path to Glory content in this book is divided into two parts: the Anvil of Apotheosis and Paths for Sylvaneth units.

sections.name: The Anvil of Apotheosis
sections.text:
There are 6 steps to follow to create your hero:
1. Set a destiny point limit.
2. Pick a starting warscroll.
3. Pick your hero’s origin and/or flaw.
4. Pick a Battle Mount.
5. Pick any Battle Mount Upgrades.
6. Pick any other upgrades.

sections.name: Step 1 - Set a Destiny Point Limit
sections.text:
The Anvil of Apotheosis uses a currency called destiny points. First, you need to set a destiny point limit. This will determine how many destiny points you have to spend on your hero, what type of hero they will be and what their battle profile points cost will be.
Pick 1 of the following:
HERO TYPE | DESTINY POINT LIMIT | BATTLE PROFILE POINTS COST
Grove Warden | 10 | 150
Glade Guardian | 30 | 250
Forest Ancient | 50 | 350
Over the next few steps, you will pick options for your hero. Each option has a destiny point cost, abbreviated as DP. Keep a record of the number of destiny points you have spent. You cannot exceed the limit you have set.

sections.name: Step 2 - Fill Out The Starting Warscroll
sections.text: To begin with, pick 1 of the following starting warscrolls for your hero:

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Sweeping Branches is 3.

sections.name: Step 3 - Pick Your Hero's Origin And/Or Flaw
sections.text: You can pick up to 1 origin and up to 1 flaw for your hero. Each adds an ability to your hero’s warscroll. However, instead of costing destiny points, flaws give you extra destiny points to spend elsewhere.

sections.text:

sections.name: Step 4 - Pick a Battle Mount
sections.text:
You can pick up to 1 Battle Mount for your hero.
Battle Mount
-4DP
SWARM OF SPITES: This forest spirit is carried, surrounded or even inhabited by a great swarm of spites, whose razor-sharp mouthparts or venomous stingers overwhelm foes who stray too close.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Swarm of Spites
Crit (Mortal), Companion | 10 | 4+ | 4+ | - | 1
Battle Mount
-6DP
DRAGONSPITE: It is a mark of great honour to ride one of these enormous flying insectoids to battle.
INFANTRY HERO only. Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Sharp Mandibles
Companion | 3 | 4+ | 3+ | 1 | 2
In addition, make the following changes to your hero's warscroll:

Change the Health characteristic to 7.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the CAVALRY keyword.
Add the FLY keyword.

INFANTRY HERO only. Add the following weapon and ability to your hero’s warscroll:

Razor-like Mandibles
Companion | 4 | 4+ | 2+ | 2 | 3
Passive
BATTLE DAMAGED Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Razor-like Mandibles is 3.
In addition, make the following changes to your hero's warscroll:

Change the Save characteristic to 3+.
Change the Health characteristic to 14.
Change the Control characteristic to 5.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the MONSTER keyword.

sections.name: Path of The Verdant Lord
sections.text:
(SYLVANETH HERO only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
NATURAL REGENERATION
Effect: When using the ‘Endless Growth’ ability, do not roll a D3 for this unit. Instead, Heal (3) this unit.
Passive
SONG OF SPITE
Effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with this unit if this unit charged in the same turn.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
TERRITORIAL
Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks while it is wholly within the creeping overgrowth.
Passive
JADE EXEMPLAR
Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls and banishment rolls for this unit while it is wholly within the creeping overgrowth.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Turn, Reaction: This unit was picked to be the target of a non- CORE ability
BARKSCARRED
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
Passive
BOUNTIFUL RADIANCE
Effect: You can measure the creeping overgrowth range from this unit.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Your Hero Phase
SONG OF THE LAND
Effect: Give every objective and terrain feature within 18" of this unit an overgrown token. You can measure the creeping overgrowth from objectives that have a friendly overgrown token.
Your Movement Phase
TRICK OF THE DARK
Declare: Pick a friendly Awakened Wyldwood to be the target.
Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of this unit, more than 1" from all enemy units and other terrain features and more than 3" from all objectives. Then, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within the creeping overgrowth and more than 9" from all enemy units.

Any Movement Phase

LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick l of the following abilities for them:

Effect: When using the ‘Endless Growth’ ability, add X to the D3 roll for this unit, where X is the number of terrain features within 12" of this unit that have a friendly overgrown token.
Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase

Effect: If this unit is not in combat and has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within the creeping overgrowth and more than 9" from all enemy units.
